question: What are the measured costs of binary ingestion, warm/fresh evaluation, new-process startup, bare Session initialization and Lisp-owned Core4 bootstrap on one hosted CPU?
claim: Measures paired exact-D2 ingest and parse-lower-execute, plus separately timed fresh OS processes, bare Session, D3 executable and Lisp-owned Core4 bootstrap when available. Preserves raw samples and blocked evidence. Does not measure truly cold page cache, complete file framing/width metadata, process memory or cross-language winners.
